page.overview:
What is Jehesic?

Jehesic was a small, fortified island nation in the Lat-Nam Straits during the Dark Age. It was ruled by Lady Edara, with the sorceress Ferantia serving as the lady's second in command. It lay south across the strait from Iwset, bordering the Ilesemare Sea.
